jobs.description: Project Manager EMEA (Stuttgart, Germany)Why Joining De NoraDe Nora is an Italian multinational company and a global leader in electrochemical technologies. Since 1923, we've been developing advanced solutions for industrial processes, water treatment, and the energy transition, including green hydrogen, transforming scientific innovation into real-world, scalable impact. We value learning, innovation, and professional growth, offering our professionals the opportunity to work on meaningful, high-tech projects with global relevance. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, guided by sustainability, collaboration, and respect, where different backgrounds, skills, and perspectives are valued.About the roleAs part of the Integrated Water Solutions business segment within De Nora's Water Technologies, you will be based in Stuttgart, Germany, and lead industrial water and wastewater projects from contract award through to successful handover. You will coordinate multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in line with contractual and technical requirements.Key ResponsibilitiesProject Coordination & Stakeholder Management- Manage all project stakeholders and interfaces across clients, engineering, procurement, construction, and subcontractors- Act as main point of contact for clients and ensure clear, transparent communicationProject Cost Control & Contract Management- Own and drive project financial performance, ensuring achievement of gross margin targets- Develop and control budgets, monitor costs, and implement corrective actions when needed- Identify risks and opportunities and manage contract/claim processes- Perform change management at project level helping individuals understand, internalize and support a changeProject & Resource Planning- Lead project planning, scheduling, and resource allocation- Ensure on-time delivery through effective monitoring and coordinationTechnical Project Management- Coordinate engineering activities and ensure efficient workload distribution- Participate in technical meetings and ensure compliance with contractual and technical requirementsQuality, Safety & Site Execution- Ensure HSE compliance and coordinate site execution activities- Oversee construction and commissioning to ensure quality and contractual compliance- Ensure successful system handover to the clientProject Monitoring & Reporting- Track project progress, performance, and KPIs- Provide clear reporting and drive continuous project improvementsRequirements- Degree in Engineering or comparable technical qualification- Extended experience in project management of industrial plant projects (€1–10M), including parallel projects- Strong expertise in budgeting, cost control, and resource planning- Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills incl. leading project teams (5+ people)- Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented working style- Experience in risk and contract management- Ability to work with technical drawings and documentation- Proficient in MS Office and project tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera)- Fluent in English and German- Willingness to travel (EMEA)- Valid driver’s license B- EPC and/or pipeline construction experience is a plusWhat we offer- Your well-being matters – benefit from a flexible health budget you can use for preventive medical check-ups, glasses, professional dental cleanings, and more.- Your future is important to us – we support your long-term financial security with a company pension scheme (betriebliche Altersvorsorge) and up to 20% employer contribution.- Your everyday life should be easier – enjoy access to a Corporate Benefits program with exclusive discounts and special offers across a wide range of shops, brands, and products.- Stay mobile and sustainable – with our company bike leasing program, you can easily lease your dream bike while promoting your health and protecting the environment.Your health is important to us – that’s why we continue to support you financially beyond the statutory 6 weeks in case of illness.Kindly ensure that all application documents are submitted in English.Recruiting ProcessOur selection process is designed to foster mutual understanding between the candidate and De Nora. It typically includes technical interviews, and in-depth discussions with the Hiring Manager and HR, promoting a dialogue that supports alignment on expectations, role scope, and values, and enables an informed decision for both parties.To learn more about the different steps and how to best prepare, please read the dedicated article on our Open Blog: Job interview at De Nora (https://open.denora.com/en/job-interview-de-nora) .About Us- Our Company: Dive into De Nora’s World (https://denora.com/en/about-de-nora)- Our three business segments: Solutions (https://denora.com/en)  | De Nora- Our People: OPEN by De Nora (https://open.denora.com/en) | Surprising pathsÜbersetzung des AG:Projektmanager EMEA (Stuttgart, Deutschland)HauptaufgabenProjektkoordination & Stakeholder Management - Koordination aller Stakeholder-Projekte sowie der Schnittstellen zwischen Kunden, Engineering, Einkauf, Bauausführung und Subunternehmen. - Übernahme der Funktion als zentraler Ansprechpartner für Kunden sowie Sicherstellung einer klaren und transparenten Kommunikation. Projektkostenkontrolle & Vertragsmanagement - Verantwortung für die finanzielle Entwicklung und Wirtschaftlichkeit der Projekte sowie Sicherstellung der Erreichung der angestrebten Bruttomargen. - Erstellung und Überwachung von Projektbudgets, Kontrolle der Kosten sowie Einleitung von Korrekturmaßnahmen bei Bedarf. - Identifikation von Risiken und Chancen sowie Steuerung von Vertrags- und Nachtragsmanagementprozessen. - Durchführung von Change-Management-Maßnahmen auf Projektebene, um die Beteiligten dabei zu unterstützen, Veränderungen zu verstehen, anzunehmen und aktiv mitzutragen. Projekt- und Ressourcenplanung - Verantwortung für die Projekt- und Terminplanung und Zuweisung von Ressourcen. - Sicherstellung der termingerechten Projektabwicklung durch eine effektive Überwachung und Koordination. Technisches Projektmanagement - Koordination der technischen Planungs- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten sowie Sicherstellung einer effizienten Arbeitsverteilung. - Teilnahme an technischen Besprechungen und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung vertraglicher und technischer Anforderungen.Qualität, Sicherung und Bauausführung - Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Gesundheits-, Sicherheits- und Umweltschutzvorschriften (HSE) sowie der Koordination der Arbeiten vor Ort. - Überwachung der Bauausführung und Inbetriebnahme, um die Einhaltung der Qualitätsstandards und vertraglichen Anforderungen sicherzustellen. - Sicherstellung einer erfolgreichen Übergabe der Anlagen an die Kunden. Projektüberwachung und Reporting - Überwachung des Projektfortschritts, der Projektleistung sowie relevanter KPIs. - Erstellung transparenter und aussagekräftiger Projektberichte sowie Förderung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Projektabläufen. Voraussetzungen - Abgeschlossenes Studium im Ingenieurwesen oder vergleichbare technische Qualifikation- Mehrjährige, umfassende Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, von industriellen Anlagebauprojekten mit einem Projektvolumen von 1 bis 10 Millionen Euro, einschließlich der gleichzeitigen Betreuung mehrere Projekte. - Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Budgetplanung, Kostenkontrolle und Ressourceplanung.- Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Kompetenzen, einschließlich der Erfahrung in der Leistung von Projektteams mit mindestens fünf Mitarbeitenden.- Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. - Erfahrung im Risiko- und Vertragsmanagement. - Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen und Dokumentationen zu verstehen und damit zu arbeiten. - Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office sowie Projektmanagement-Tools (z.B. MS Project, Primavera).- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. - Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen innerhalb der EMEA-Regionen.- Gültiger Führerschein der Klasse B. - Erfahrung in EPC und/oder im Rohrleitungsbau ist ein Plus.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Change-ManagementExpertenkenntnisse: Terminplanung, -überwachung, Projektmanagement

Auch internationale Reisetätigkeit gehört hier dazu.  Erfahrungen aus dem Rettungsdienst, ein natur- oder wirtschaftswissenschaftlicher Background oder eine Ausbildung in der Intensiv- bzw. Notfallmedizin bringen zusätzlich wertvolles Know-how mit und runden das persönliche Profil ideal ab. _________________________________________________________________________ Professional experience in international sales within the medical technology sector is a valuable advantage--it helps in understanding the diversity of our market and navigating new situations with confidence. Interacting with people from different cultures and collaborating in English--both spoken and written--are naturally part of your daily routine.Digital tools such as MS Office, CRM, and ERP systems are familiar companions, and you use them confidently to work efficiently and in a structured manner. If you enjoy growing beyond yourself as part of a team, trying out new approaches, and going the extra mile together, this is exactly the right place for you. International travel is also a natural part of the role. Experience in emergency medical services, a background in natural or economic sciences, or training in intensive or emergency care provides additional valuable expertise and ideally rounds off your profile. Become part of Tanso and decarbonize industries with us.What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title?Not through marketing spin. Not through vague "purpose-driven" messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact.That's what Tanso is building. And it's one of the reasons people join us.Why Tanso?• Take Action in a Fast-Moving, High-Impact Environment. We move fast on sustainability because the urgency is real. That means decisions that matter, transparent processes, and the agility to navigate change.• Challenge & Grow Through Ownership. Take ownership immediately, build expertise through hands-on experience, and leverage every available resource to achieve outsized impact.• Foster Trust with Mission-Driven Collaborators. You'll join a team that prioritizes impact and each other. We give honest feedback, share credit, support each other when it matters, and hold high standards together.• Embrace Responsibility & Drive Impact. Turn fragmented emissions data into actionable insights. Your work has immediate, visible impact - clearer decision-making and genuine momentum toward change.• AI First-Mindset. We embrace cutting-edge technology to solve sustainability challenges. Push the boundaries of innovation and stay ahead of what's possible.• Commitment to Performance & Excellence. We cultivate a high-performance culture where you thrive. Push yourself and others to excel, celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and raise the bar.Your roleTo build the engine that lets Customer Success scale, we are looking for a Customer Strategy & Operations Manager (f/m/x) .As a Customer Strategy & Operations Manager, you will shape how Customer Success works at Tanso, from operating model and data to tooling, automation and scaled customer formats. Working closely with our Head of CS, you take ideas from concept to hands-on execution and make every CSM more impactful: more customers served, more value delivered, targets hit.Key responsibilities• Strategy & Operations: You shape how Customer Success operates. Together with the Head of CS, you continuously sharpen our operating model (segmentation, lifecycle, playbooks) and OKR/goal process – and bring it to life, from concept to rollout. As the central link to Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering and Climate Intelligence, you make sure everything we build and do is aligned on customer value.• Tooling & Process Excellence: You keep the CS engine running and make it run smarter. You own and build our tech stack hands-on (HubSpot, Intercom, no-/low-code) and use automation and AI to free up CSMs to focus on what matters most: our customers.• Scaled Engagement & Enablement: You help CS scale. You build and run 1:n formats such as Tanso Academy, Tanso Update and our customer advisory board, and grow our customer community. With playbooks and templates, you enable CSMs to serve more customers without compromising on quality.• Projects & Strategic Initiatives: You turn ideas into impact. You lead cross-functional CS projects from concept to execution: pilot fast, measure impact, then scale or kill.Your profile• You have experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy & Operations or consulting, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.• You think in data: you build dashboards and analyses that answer real questions, and translate insights into clear priorities and actions.• You are hands-on with tools. You have worked with CRM and customer engagement platforms (ideally HubSpot and Intercom), enjoy building automations with no-/low-code tools, and are curious about using AI in daily work.• You have led cross-functional projects end to end and know how to align stakeholders across multiple departments.• You combine structured, strategic thinking with a pragmatic drive to get things done. You spot problems early, take ownership and see solutions through.• You communicate clearly and confidently, whether you’re writing a playbook or aligning with leadership.• You're business-fluent in English and German, both written and spoken.• You're based in Munich or willing to relocate.Nice to Have• Experience with scaled CS programs (webinars, academies, communities).• Interest in sustainability and carbon accounting.What we offer• A highly competitive compensation package with an attractive equity package to participate in Tanso's growth.• Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed.• A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security.• Yearly budget to support ongoing professional development.• Sponsored access to EGYM Wellpass to prioritize your wellbeing with thousands of options.• Exclusive discounts that help you save on a wide range of everyday brands, services, and experiences.Our teamWe're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves.About usTanso is an integrated sustainability software for carbon accounting and ESG data management. Our goal is to help manufacturing companies meet regulatory requirements and achieve their sustainability objectives.TansoWorking at Tanso

still creating meaningful customer outcomes.• You bring strong communication skills, both in writing and in customer conversations, and can clearly articulate value to technical users, business environments.• You seek opportunities with a business and sales mind-set to find win/win solutions and grow the pie• You have an affinity for software tools and experience using Microsoft Office, CRM systems such as Salesforce, and Account Management or Customer Success tools.• Fluent in English and German (written and spoken), additional European languages are a plusWhy you will love MaltegoMaltego is a scale-up company. We are proud to have a large global community that loves our product because it helps to solve the investigations that are most important. Here are some of the reasons why you will love Maltego:• Make an impact: Work in a scale-up environment with the opportunity to take ownership and make a direct, lasting contribution.• 30 days of paid vacation to relax, recharge, and enjoy life outside of work• Your wellbeing matters: Access mental health support and 1:1 sessions with certified psychologists through Nilo• Keep learning: Maltego supports your development, including subsidies for eligible language courses• Connect beyond the day-to-day: Join company events and celebrations that bring our international community together.• Collaborate with talented and mission-driven teams across the business.At Maltego, we are committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, religion, color, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.LocationBased in our Munich office, with a flexible hybrid working model requiring a minimum of 3 days per week in the officeRequired documents / informationReady to help drive the future of digital investigations? Apply now with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your experience!About usMaltego is the all-in-one investigation platform that accelerates complex cyber and OSINT investigations from hours to minutes. The Maltego platform powers preliminary quick OSINT investigations for digital profiling with Maltego Search as well as complex link analysis for large datasets with Maltego Graph. Through Maltego Evidence and Maltego Monitor, the platform enables investigators to collect, monitor, and preserve social media intelligence in real-time for prosecution and public safety. Whether cyber threat intelligence teams or law enforcement, Maltego equips your teams with the most essential and relevant data, with out-of-the-box access to common data sources and over 100 ready-made connectors to more. Mine, merge, and map all your essential intelligence in one place, and uncover hidden truths with Maltego!Learn more about how we can empower your investigations at www.maltego.com.

jobs.occupation: Technical Manager (m/f/d) Instrument Units (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: Technical Manager (m/f/d) Instrument UnitsPayload TeamDue to our increased engagement in the area of laser interferometric instruments in collaboration with international partners and institutes, we are hiring new employees to strengthen our team in Payload.Your tasks- Serve as the primary responsible and direct point of contact for the subcontractor assigned to an interferometric instrument unit, e.g. frequency reference system- Coordinate, implement, and monitor the subcontractor’s development activities- Conduct technical assessments and, if necessary, perform shadow engineering- Collaborate with engineers across the company as part of the payload team- Negotiate change requests and manage contract change notices- Ensure compliance with contractual requirements regarding quality, cost, and schedule- Report regularly to the project manager- Organize and lead technical meetings and project reviewsYour skills and experience- Proven experience in development and project management for space projects (minimum 3 years each, minimum 5 years in total)- Strong understanding of laser-optical systems (e.g. cavity) or electrical units (e.g. ICU)- Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and foster a culture of inclusion- Able to work independently as well as within interdisciplinary teams- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is a definite asset- Master’s degree or PhD in Physics, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline- Willingness and ability to travel frequently within Europe on short noticeWe offer- Diverse tasks in the area of high-end space technology- Opportunity for personal impact and development possibilities in flat company hierarchies- Living and working in an area of natural beauty and safety offering a large variety of leisure activities- Profit sharing, company pension scheme, flexible home office rules and many more...This position will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

Was Sie erwartetMöchtest du dazu beitragen, den weltweiten Übergang zur nachhaltigen Energie zu beschleunigen?  Bei Tesla ist das unsere Mission! Wir suchen talentierte Kfz-Technikerinnen für Teslas Service Center in ganz Deutschland. Bei Tesla sind unsere Mechanikerinnen das Rückgrat des Servicebetriebs und unterstützen unsere Mission, den weltweiten Übergang zu nachhaltiger Energie zu beschleunigen. Wir haben eines der innovativsten Fahrzeuge aller Zeiten entwickelt, und als Servicetechniker*in trägst du dazu bei, unserer Kundschaft einen ebenso innovativen Service zu bieten. Wir bieten:- Karriereentwicklung und Weiterbildung: Bei Tesla hast du die Möglichkeit zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Performance Reviews, gezielte Trainingsmaßnahmen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. Hochvoltschulungen, Managementtrainings)- Unternehmenskultur: Tauche ein in unsere inspirierende Unternehmenskultur, in der Innovation, Teamwork und Leidenschaft im Mittelpunkt stehen- Innovative Projekte und Technologien: Du hast die Chance, an wegweisenden Projekten und Technologien zu arbeiten, die die Zukunft der Automobilindustrie und nachhaltiger Energie mitgestalten- Vorteile und Zusatzleistungen: Dich erwartet ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalts- und Leistungspaket, das neben Tesla Aktien oder einem CashAward auch den Zugang zu unserem Corporate Benefits Programm, 30 Tage Urlaub, ein 13. Monatsgehalt sowie die Option auf eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket umfasst - Engagiertes Team und positive Arbeitsatmosphäre: Arbeite in einem engagierten und motivierten Team, das sich durch eine tolle Stimmung und hervorragende Teamarbeit auszeichnet. Sei Teil eines Teams, das einen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Zukunft und zu erneuerbaren Energien leistet  Was zu tun ist- Service, Reparatur und Verbesserung: Mit Tesla-spezifischer Software und fortschrittlichen Tools führst du Reparaturen und Wartungen an allen Arten von Tesla-Fahrzeugen durch  - Qualitätssicherstellung: Wir vertrauen darauf, dass du unsere Fahrzeuge vor der Rückgabe und Vorablieferung sorgfältig prüfst und mit dem höchsten Qualitätsstandards arbeitest - Zusammenarbeit: Wenn du teamübergreifend (lokal und regional) arbeitest, tausche dich aus und Teile deine Erfahrung, um das Serviceerlebnis weiter zu verbessern - Entwicklung: Bereite dich auf den Erfolg vor. Unsere engagierten internen Schulungsteams schulen dich in Tesla-spezifischer Technologie und der Reparatur von Elektrofahrzeugen Was mitzubringen ist- Technische Erfahrung: Du verfügst über Berufserfahrung in der Durchführung von Fahrzeugservice und Reparaturarbeiten in der Automobil-, Luftfahrt-, Marine- oder ähnlichen Industrien - Technische Qualifizierung: Du verfügst über eine entsprechende Zertifizierung, um in Deutschland Fahrzeugreparaturen durchführen zu können (Ausbildung zum Mechatroniker*in) - Verantwortlichkeit: Du übernimmst eine Vorreiterrolle bei Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsbedenken, die während der Arbeit auftreten - Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du sprichst und schreibst gut Deutsch und weißt, wie du deinen Standpunkt klar und respektvoll vermitteln kannst - Teamfähigkeit und Flexibilität: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit verschiedenen Menschen zusammen und kannst gute Arbeitsbeziehungen zu allen internen Interessengruppen aufbauen und pflegen. Du kannst im Schichtdienst arbeiten, um dein Team zu unterstützen. Dies können auch Wochenenden sowie Morgen- und Abendschichten umfassen (bei einer 5-Tage Woche) - Fahrerlaubnis: Du besitzt einen gültigen EU-Führerschein der Klasse B - Berechtigung: Du besitzt eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für DeutschlandENGLISH VERSIONPlease note that experience or training in the automotive sector is crucial for the recognition of your qualifications. Therefore, while we can initiate the recruiting process immediately, we can only issue a final employment contract once the recognition of your vocational training in Germany is fully completed.Further information can be found at: https://www.anerkennung-in-deutschland.de/html/en/getting-recognition.phpWe are looking for talented Automotive Technicians for Tesla's Service Centers. At Tesla, our Mechanics are the backbone of the Service operation, supporting our mission. We’ve created one of the most innovative vehicles ever made, and as a Service Technician you will help ensure an equally innovative service to our customers.We offer:Provision and Additional Benefits• Above-average salary• 13th-month salary• Choice between Tesla stock or a cash bonus• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (opportunity to purchase Tesla stock at a discounted price)• Permanent employment contract• Saturday work allowance of 25%• Company pension scheme• Life insurance• Occupational disability insurance• Accident insurance for business travel• Further insurance discounts• Bonuses for successful employee referralsDiscounts and Recognition• Tesla apparel and workwear (incl. laptop for work)• Exclusive corporate benefits• Discount in the Tesla Online Shop• Upgrade option to “Full Self-Driving Capability”Health and Wellbeing• Choice between a discounted Urban Sports Club membership or a wellness allowance• 30 days of vacation• Special leave for events such as moving, marriage, or bereavement• Employee Assistance Program “Fürstenberg” (free, confidential support for personal or professional challenges)• Company doctor, medical checks, and consultations• Additional personal work equipment (e.g., computer glasses)• Free drinks and fruit• Overtime meals/cateringMobility and Transport• Subsidized “Deutschland-Job-Ticket”• Next Bike rental discounts• Job Bike leasing (tax-advantaged)Learning and Development• Online learning platform• Internal training programs (including topics such as high-voltage training and leadership training)• Onboarding in Berlin• Regular feedback sessions and performance reviewsWhat You’ll DoYou will- Service, repair and improve: Working with Tesla specific software and advanced tools you will be performing repairs and maintenance on all types of Tesla vehicles, with and without supervision according to skill level- Ensure top quality: Fix it right first time, we trust you to inspect our vehicles diligently before return and pre-delivery and to work with the highest quality standards- Collaborate: Working across teams (local and regional) you will be sharing support and best practices to further improve the service experience- Develop: Setting you up for success, our dedicated in-house training teams will train you on Tesla specific technology and the repair of Electrical VehiclesWhat You’ll Bring- Technically experienced: You have professional experience performing vehicle service and repairs working within either automotive, aviation, marine or similar industries,- Technically qualified: You ideally have relevant certification to perform vehicle repairs. However, this is not a requirement. You will self-manage your technical expertise development,- A good communicator: You speak and write English well and know how to get your point across clearly and respectfully- Safe to drive: We require you to hold a full driver’s license- Flexible: You may work in shifts to support your team, which may include weekends, morning, and evening shifts. You are willing to travel for mobile repairs when needed.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Korrosionsschutz, Fahrzeuglackierung, KarosseriearbeitenExpertenkenntnisse: Fahrzeugdiagnose, Fahrzeugsysteme-Mechatronik
